'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Joe Young LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Young]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Joseph Young
* '''Deck name:''' Local Uprising Endor
* '''Username:''' joe young
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
